description: AI-powered face recognition system to help dementia patients remember people's names
use_case: Assist dementia patients by showing name bubbles over recognized faces

workflow.training_phase: Send 5 images per person to Gemini with names attached
workflow.recognition_phase: Show bubbles on detected faces in real-time
workflow.interaction_phase: Tap bubbles to display person names in popups

accessibility: Designed for dementia patients with simple, clear interface
